subject: Meteorology
title: Potential Temperature
description: A quick win: understand Potential Temperature.

hook.text: Comparing temperatures at different altitudes is tricky—pressure differences skew the numbers.

buildup.text: Potential temperature solves this by adjusting every air parcel's temperature to a common pressure level.

discovery.text: It's the temperature air would have if brought to 1000 hPa without exchanging heat—a true apples-to-apples read.

twist.text: Potential temperature stays constant as dry air rises or sinks—making it a conserved quantity in meteorology.

climax.text: Forecasters use it to track air masses across different levels without pressure confusing the picture.

punchline.text: Same air, different altitude—potential temperature is steady.

quiz.question: What pressure level is used as the reference for potential temperature?
